case_title: PROMETHEUS STOLE FIRE FROM THE GODS
title: PROMETHEUS

beats.label: hook
beats.text: Prometheus stole fire from the gods. His punishment was an eagle eating his liver every single day, for eternity.

beats.label: setup
beats.text: In Greek mythology, Zeus had withheld fire from humans, keeping them weak and animalistic. But Prometheus, a Titan, sided with mortals over the gods.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: Prometheus hid burning embers inside a hollow fennel stalk and smuggled them down from Mount Olympus. Humanity could now cook food, forge metal, and survive winter. Civilization was born.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Zeus chained Prometheus to a rock in the Caucasus mountains. Every single day, an eagle ate his liver, which regenerated overnight. The torment was eternal, until Hercules eventually freed him centuries later.

spoken_text: Prometheus stole fire from the gods. His punishment was an eagle eating his liver every single day, for eternity. In Greek mythology, Zeus had withheld fire from humans, keeping them weak and animalistic. But Prometheus, a Titan, sided with mortals over the gods. Prometheus hid burning embers inside a hollow fennel stalk and smuggled them down from Mount Olympus. Humanity could now cook food, forge metal, and survive winter. Civilization was born. Zeus chained Prometheus to a rock in the Caucasus mountains. Every single day, an eagle ate his liver, which regenerated overnight. The torment was eternal, until Hercules eventually freed him centuries later.
